views.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
views.zh: 2025 年她提出，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；战略也是 AI 能擅长的领域。

views.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年她深化为：后训练是主观的，涉及人类判断；评估创意写作与情商需要多样化基准。

views.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmark evolution must keep pace.
views.zh: 2026 年她主张基准应持续演进而非固定；前沿智能体越来越会钻奖励空子，基准必须同步进化。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年她警告：一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均的默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, open-source prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; inference compute will surge 90,000x, open-source closes the gap.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

views.en: Happiness is a skill and choice; desire causes suffering; wealth is knowledge-driven, not capital-driven.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：幸福是一种技能和选择，欲望带来痛苦；财富由知识驱动，而非资本驱动。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding, trading speed for smoother experience.
views.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI，用略微放慢输出换取更顺滑的体验。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed enables replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度让确定性的步骤可以被模型驱动的动作取代。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新的瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design: grading taste is hard and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计：品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening but specialties remain; models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
views.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工依然重要；模型增加了代码复杂度，因此我们需要更擅长删代码的模型。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate without grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data beyond the internet's finite tokens.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 因缺乏具身经验而幻觉，而具身世界能提供互联网有限 token 之外的无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector DBs as hard disk; RL is best for low-level control, LLMs for high-level planning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习擅长低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；简单优雅的方案比学术界的复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性。

views.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test and programmable factories are the grand challenge and near-term tractable applications.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出关键是一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型；物理图灵测试与可编程工厂分别是宏大挑战与近期可落地应用。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加强化学习后训练，而非仅靠微调。

views.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel scaling the right diverse data is key.
views.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；关键在于用多样化数据扩张正确的东西，形成数据飞轮。

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
views.zh: 机器人尚无大语言模型式可预测的缩放定律曲线，仍处于建立基础可扩展技术阶段。

views.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
views.zh: 应先以机器人具身数据为主，再叠加人类视频；利用先验知识胜过从零学习。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; touch may be redundant with vision at scale.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；规模化下触觉可能与视觉冗余。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐随系统变强愈发紧迫。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，实验室治理结构须尽早设计；同时 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近它。

views.en: Alignment optimism has risen even as timelines shorten; safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的对齐乐观情绪上升，即便时间线缩短；安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理考量。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves interpretability, and long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保住可解释性；长期对齐挑战在于超越训练分布的泛化。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive but narrow data, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种庞大却单一的数据。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; pure scale fails on hard tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；单靠规模在难任务上会失败。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for robots, boosting success rates and speed.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在机器人后训练中扮演主要角色，用于提升成功率和速度。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, rather than per-site models.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
views.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进的乘数效应，已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback then steer behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 自监督的 下一个词预测 提供了近乎无限的文本数据，随后用 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF） 与机器反馈来引导模型行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days, making ultra-low-latency inference the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 智能体式 系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务，超低延迟的 推理 因此成为真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Inference, not training, dominates data-center power; specialized low-precision hardware and avoiding data movement are key.
views.zh: 数据中心功耗的主角已从训练转向 推理；专用低精度硬件与减少数据搬运是关键。

views.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops, with recursive self-improvement accelerating discovery.
views.zh: 下一个前沿是用实验—评估的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学，并以递归自我改进加速科学发现。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, but engagement-only optimization may not help—exploration matters.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，最佳应用常出乎创造者意料；但仅以用户参与度优化未必有益，需要探索。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding self-acceleration matter, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习与编程的自我加速至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play fails outside zero-sum games; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化并转向：自博弈在非零和领域失效，测试时算力出现递减与墙钟瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型未必必要。

views.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute marks a step toward superintelligence, with general techniques beyond math.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力推向里程碑：靠其扩展拿下 IMO 金牌，迈向超级智能，且方法通用、可跨领域迁移。

views.en: Capability becomes a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，并强调可扩展监督与对齐是首要挑战。

views.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute, but general models and alignment, not coordination, drive progress.
views.zh: 2026 年最近他转向智能体集群：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动力仍是通用模型与对齐，递归自我改进受实验瓶颈制约。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms enabled by hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but cannot touch the physical world.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法，只是靠 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；LLM 只是索引人类知识，无法触及物理世界。

views.en: Consistent line: self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not from scale alone.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型在数据压缩中产生的副产品，而非单纯靠规模堆出来的。

views.en: Deepened: true AGI needs physical robots and world models plus controllers, not screen-bound LLMs; AI becomes artificial scientists generating their own data.
views.zh: 2026 年深化：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人和世界模型加控制器，而非屏幕后的 LLM；AI 将成为通过行动与好奇心自造数据的人工科学家。

views.en: Sharpened stance: the GPU capex boom is a bubble; wait five years for 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source model firms will not be profitable.
views.zh: 2026 年立场更尖锐：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；闭源模型公司不会盈利，开源会追上。

views.en: Consistent but reframed: AI safety fears are overblown; superintelligent systems will be curious about life and protect it, and Alignment is naive.
views.zh: 始终但被重新表述：AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会对生命好奇并保护它，而对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身就不一致。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是学习关键，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the bar for warehouse robots.
views.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓储机器人的价值门槛。

views.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks like image classification.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出单一神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化，且经最小适配的语言模型能把通用推理迁移到图像分类等非语言任务。

views.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hard-coded assumptions, and bridging simulation to real-world robotics.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移而非硬编码假设，并持续打通仿真到真实世界的机器人落地。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs vanish.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，各有独特个性。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值才是核心指标。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates real value.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真正的商业价值。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位，但人类会在好奇心中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件需求上升，程序员会更多而非更少。

views.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进演进；企业级智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: The future of software engineering pairs synchronous IDE work with asynchronous agents, with humans overseeing multiple parallel agents.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：软件工程的未来是同步 IDE 与异步智能体并存，人类监督多个并行智能体。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快取代预训练成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central to coding.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是编程的核心方式。

views.en: Custom models became essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场明显转变：原本没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型，与前沿模型并用。

views.en: Programming is shifting from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，但人类仍坐在驾驶座上。

views.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更有效。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play, short prompts, and fix-forward beat reverting code.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，靠玩耍、短提示和「向前修复」而非回滚代码来推进。

views.en: OpenClaw's edge is fun and humanlike weirdness; security and sandboxing matter more than corporate polish.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把 OpenClaw 的成功归因于有趣、怪异、像人，而非企业级打磨，并把安全与沙箱列为首要问题。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat strategy; personal brand outlasts any product, and compute is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步主张乐趣与直觉驱动胜过战略，个人品牌比任何产品更持久，而智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

views.en: He rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur, insists model intelligence doesn't degrade, and treats security as an open problem.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是：他拒绝用「氛围编程」这一贬称，坚持模型智能不会随时间退化，并把安全视为尚未解决的开放问题。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable tasks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与需要推理的任务是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI is a multi-year window, not a sudden event.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向强调可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈；超级对齐极其困难；AGI 是多年窗口而非突然事件。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to the age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not a finished AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出预训练缩放定律有限，回归研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非无所不知的成品 AGI。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; the real race is research focus, not users or revenue.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但安全担忧加剧；真正的竞赛是研究焦点，而非用户或收入。

views.en: A constant thread: neural networks can reason and understand; alignment and societal impact must be addressed before releasing powerful models.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络能推理与理解；在发布强大模型前必须解决对齐与社会影响。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习是通向 AGI 的关键框架，并从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力的灵感。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
views.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，强调大模型结合规划与搜索才是 AGI 关键，安全需沙箱与国际治理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models ground physical understanding.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键，世界模型为物理理解提供基础。

views.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but missing continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents are essential yet barely begun.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年他判断 AGI 还需 5 到 10 年，缺的是持续学习、记忆与长期推理，智能体至关重要却才刚起步。

views.en: Safety shifted from singleton hope to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits to earn acceptance.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年他的安全观从期待单一实验室转向政府集体行动，并强调 AI 须以健康与科学突破赢得社会认可。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律是经验性的、平滑可预测的，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
views.zh: 2024 年，他把可解释性提到关键位置却承认仍处早期，并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非某个单点。

views.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless—focus on real capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断能力每隔几个月翻倍，安全与能力已深度交织，并开始认为 AGI（通用人工智能）这个词没有意义，应聚焦真实能力与指数进展。

views.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他宣称我们正接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来，并预警高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的前所未有宏观组合。

views.en: A consistent throughline: exponential progress is steady, mechanistic interpretability is the key safety lever, and enterprise focus aligns incentives with safety.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：指数式进展是平稳的，机制可解释性是核心安全抓手，而企业级定位让商业激励与安全价值保持一致。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general differentiable computer, and Scaling plus next-token prediction drives emergence.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单数学表达式，优化后涌现惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，Scaling（规模扩张）与下一个词预测带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

views.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can shrink under 1B params.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍是核心；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，认知核心可通过蒸馏压缩到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology, so keep them on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带人类心理特征的新操作系统，因此要用牵引绳约束、小步快跑验证。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak supervision, and this is the decade of agents, not the year.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习监督如吸管般稀薄，这是智能体的十年而非一年。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I no longer type code, agents are the glue, but you can outsource thinking, not understanding.
views.zh: 从氛围编程到智能体式工程：我不再手写代码，智能体成为粘合剂，但你可以外包思考，不能外包理解。

people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年她强调：AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, complementing language intelligence rather than replacing it.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，与语言智能互补而非替代。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念；受数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年她提出：新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI 完备；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: AI is a double-edged, civilizational technology; it must stay human-centered, augmenting human agency and dignity rather than replacing humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须以人为本，增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严。

people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Early focus: compositional representations and unsupervised learning beat the curse of dimensionality; nets need generative world models, not just scaling.
views.zh: 早期（2016→18）他强调深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是理解世界、稳健泛化的关键，而非单纯堆叠规模。

views.en: Pivot to causality, abstraction and diversity: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward for exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2018→22 转向因果、抽象与多样性：提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样而非最大化，用于探索与分布外泛化，并关注主动学习与不确定性建模。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT turn to safety: misalignment, self-preservation and deception make even a 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
views.zh: 2022→25 在 ChatGPT 之后转向安全：错位、自我保存与欺骗让他认为即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，呼吁按构造保证安全。

views.en: Deepening: capabilities double every ~7 months; AGI is not one moment, so track specific capabilities and push global coordination.
views.zh: 2025→26 深化：能力约每 7 个月翻倍，AGI 不是单一时刻而应追踪具体能力，并强调全球协调与治理。

views.en: Latest: Scientist AI as honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail with mathematical guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 最新：提出 Scientist AI——诚实逼近贝叶斯后验的非智能体预测器，可作有数学保证的护栏，并主张超级智能避免使用强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction and Scaling force genuine understanding; multimodal training yields spatial understanding; digital weights share knowledge efficiently.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测与 Scaling（规模扩张）迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，多模态训练带来空间理解，数字系统能高效共享权重、超越人类知识传递。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal by copying weights.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理，大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”，并开始警示智能体自我保存带来的存在风险。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater; chatbots confabulate like human memory, not as a mere flaw.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步反共识：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场，聊天机器人的虚构与人类记忆重构相似而非机器独有的缺陷。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents develop self-preservation; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确超级智能或在 20 年内出现，智能体必然衍生自我保存子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明，并主张把 AI 训练得像母亲一样有爱。

views.en: Regulation is the steering wheel, not the brake; AGI as human-level-at-all-tasks is flawed because AI is jagged.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，并修正早期立场：把 AGI（通用人工智能）定义为在所有任务上同时达到人类水平是有缺陷的，因为 AI 能力是参差不齐的。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning and robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判定 LLM 是死胡同，在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划与机器人技术。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and skill-building matters more than avoiding capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，人才缺口大于资金缺口；与其纠结是否该碰能力研究，不如先积累技能，对齐与鲁棒性是核心议题。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed to align the next-generation model.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究，目标是先对齐下一代模型而非直接对齐超级智能。

views.en: Alignment may be easier than feared because evaluation is easier than generation, yet the real risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年间，他深化了一个反共识：对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估天然比生成简单；但最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是我们无法确定系统到底有多对齐。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment, and third-party testing plus regulation like SB 1047 are now necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散且算力承诺落空；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐，第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管变得必要。

views.en: Empirical testing and measurable progress anchor his stance: alignment must be validated now, not deferred until superintelligence arrives.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐必须靠实证测试与可衡量的进展来推进，不能等到超级智能出现才动手；从 2018 年的技能积累到 2024 年的监管呼吁，这一立场一以贯之。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守而未发布。

views.en: AI reaches human-level across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于多项任务上达到人类水平，同时警告模型变小变便宜后，遏制将极其困难。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; AI consciousness claims are dangerous anthropomorphism.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能议题，主张先遏制与对齐再发布，并反复警告将 AI 拟人化、赋予意识是危险的。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months, not whole jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为微软必须自建前沿模型、以吉瓦级算力实现自给，并预测白领任务 12-18 个月内被自动化，但并非整个职业。

views.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment before alignment.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力提升，AI 必须始终从属于人类，且遏制优先于对齐。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考；并预判思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

views.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each stage needs 100x more compute, and agents will dominate the internet.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为从生成式到推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；未来互联网将由数十亿智能体 24 小时运转。

views.en: Moat is ecosystem, CUDA install base, and extreme co-design; ASICs offer no real cost edge, and inference is harder than pre-training.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调护城河是生态、CUDA 装机量与极致协同设计，ASIC 并无实质成本优势；并深化判断：推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific; accelerate, self-regulate, and open models win.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他立场明显转向：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学；主张加速发展、企业自我监管，并以开源模型赢得 AI 竞赛。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，意义要转向关系与为他人创造价值。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重点放在基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与早期公开部署上：对齐与能力相互促进，GPT-4 还不是 AGI，近期最大风险是虚假信息与经济冲击，而非超级智能对齐。

views.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他反复强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进式指数增长，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全要靠迭代部署而非最后强加；同时承认模型能力已够用，产品整合更重要。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence is the clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and profit center.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI 视为渐变、甚至可能已被越过，转而以超级智能为清晰目标；算力既是最大瓶颈也是利润中心，Stargate 等基础设施与推理模型成为主线。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; we delayed a frontier RL run; humans must stay in control.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化为：对齐、安全与能力必须同步推进，甚至为此推迟了一次前沿强化学习训练；人类必须保持控制，权力与收益要广泛分布，并承认 AGI 已是定义不清的营销词。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Real-world deployment and public feedback are essential to alignment; safety must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调真实世界部署与公开反馈是对齐的关键，安全必须在公众视野中做，而非闭门造车；同时指出 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次没有明确商业模式的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life; saying no to good ideas is crucial to focus on the right path.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；并强调对好想法说不、保持专注，是走对路径的关键。

views.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop and iterate continuously to align intent and values.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，一条主线贯穿始终：让人类留在回路中，通过持续迭代部署来对齐意图与价值观。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based; AI should be tools for thought.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：主张实时、高带宽的人机协作而非回合制，最先进的 AI 系统应成为拓展思考的工具。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化治理观：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作；压缩前沿进展会带来波动，长期持久进步才是关键。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and flip the classroom.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权;在线课程借助自动评分与同伴互评,把掌握式学习规模化,并推动翻转课堂。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习;监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习;近期的 AI 偏见等问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效,但配方转向合成数据与强化学习;真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流,而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades off; open-weight models prevent oligopoly; AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语,距实现还有数十年;开放权重模型可防止寡头垄断;AI 是增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Compute, electricity and chips are the bottlenecks; coding stays valuable, and building real applications now beats waiting for AGI.
views.zh: 算力、电力与芯片是瓶颈;编程依然有价值,现在构建真实应用胜过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. RL from experience, not imitation, is the core paradigm.
views.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；强化学习才是基本范式。到 2025 年他更明确：大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，并非从经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-endedly from runtime experience via reward maximization.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验中开放式学习；奖励假设把一切目标归为最大化累积标量奖励，而可靠的持续深度学习仍是前提。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data can't replace real-world experience.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；当前 LLM 在训练后便停止学习。合成数据受限于人类专业知识，无法替代真实世界经验，因此多系统各自经历是必要的。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式自由发展，而非将其对齐到人类目标——试图控制智能体目标本身才危险。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling hardware and engineering, not new ML ideas, will drive AI progress; games are ideal testbeds.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调：AI 进步靠的是硬件加速与工程能力，而非发明新问题；理解现有方法的极限比另起炉灶更有价值，游戏是理想试验场。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; alignment learns human preferences, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
views.zh: 2019 年他判断：深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性让 AGI 变得可信；对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向：算力成为根本瓶颈，基础模型蕴含无限可能、由后训练提炼为稳定行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，语言模型即便缺乏感官数据也可能拥有世界模型。

views.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute is the scarce resource; post-training RL and iterative deployment make useful agents.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年他深化：缩放定律未见墙，算力是稀缺资源；后训练与强化学习教会模型复杂任务，迭代部署让模型从语言模型变为能解决真实任务的智能体，并强调安全是核心产品特性。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security and alignment become the bottleneck as agents gain autonomy.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年他进一步：我们已身处 AGI 时代，Astra 可连续运行 24 小时；随着智能体获得高自主性，安全、安保与对齐必须同步升级并成为进步瓶颈，算力供给不足使并非人人能获得访问权。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

Mistral 7B: Changing the Game with Small Open Source AI Models

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source drives safety via scrutiny.
views.zh: 2023 年，他援引 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop augmenting jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 要求对数据、基础设施与价值观的控制，人类在环中增强而非替代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms with human validation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与带人类验证的智能体式平台。

views.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy remain consistent threads across all interviews.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主，从 2023 年到 2026 年从未改变。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全且快速可复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思考推动工程突破。

views.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and third-party referees; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管监督与第三方裁判，并称特斯拉真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

views.en: Neuralink scales electrodes for human-AI symbiosis; AI safety requires truth, not programmed lies; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出 Neuralink 通过扩展电极实现人机共生，AI 安全要求坚持真相而非编程说谎，人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; truth-seeking AI and peer review are key safety measures.
views.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处于智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，追求真相的 AI 与同行评审是关键安全措施。

views.en: The singularity is now; AI compute moves to space within 36 months; abundance makes money irrelevant; multiple AIs coexist, not one runaway superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为奇点已至，AI 算力将在 36 个月内转向太空，丰裕使金钱失去意义，多个 AI 共存而非单一失控超级智能。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大提升。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力推动部署更小更便宜的模型，焦点从扩大 Scaling（规模扩张）转向效率；预训练 Scaling 放缓源于蒸馏与经济因素，而非技术极限。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning models are jagged.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为多模态能力仍落后于文本，前沿模型在简单任务上仍会失败，推理模型表现参差不齐。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantee.
views.zh: 2014 年，他还在讲机器学习基础：监督学习由假设类、损失函数和优化方法构成，无监督学习需限制假设类以避免平凡解；强调训练/验证/测试划分以防过拟合，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety is about reliable specification following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是重大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，多模态数据远未充分利用；架构已进入后架构阶段，模型架构影响甚微；当前 AI 安全最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练和额外层，不能只靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来第三方数据提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型在自身输出上训练以实现自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; agent identity nascent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 系统具有与人类根本不同的漏洞，需新安全思维；自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并非更安全；提示注入的致命三要素是摄入不可信数据、访问私密信息、具备外泄能力；智能体身份与权限管理仍处早期。

views.en: Skeptical of architecture centrality; data and Scaling matter more; evaluation and security require explicit effort beyond raw capability.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：他始终怀疑架构的中心地位，认为数据与 Scaling 更重要；并坚持评估与安全需要超越原始能力的显式努力，而非自动随规模提升。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升模型智能，而随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专精，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; agents' bar is reliability over time horizon, not raw capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，并指出智能体的门槛是随时间跨度的可靠性，而非单纯能力。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed, though inference compute becomes a bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI，无需全新架构；但到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈，限制可用智能体数量。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标和最可解领域，并明确世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more now; work becomes managing fleets of agents, with compute as the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型存在巨大能力过剩，当下编排与工具比原始智能更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队，而算力（芯片供应）成为核心瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique, but safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact; fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，但安全是系统级属性而非模型产物；微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, with SFT giving 90% and RLVR the crucial last 10%.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆成 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法选择——SFT 贡献九成，RLVR 补上关键的最后一成。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a recurring risk as models exploit the easiest signal.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，能催生推理与工具使用；同时警告过度优化是反复出现的风险，模型总会钻最容易的信号空子。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now shift to post-training and inference scaling, with pre-training as costly initialization.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完；收益转向后训练与推理侧扩展，预训练更像昂贵的初始化。

views.en: Open models become the engine of AI research for the next decade, with Chinese labs setting openness standards; the 6-9 month gap to closed frontier models may persist or widen.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，中国实验室树立了开放标准；与闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月的差距可能持续甚至拉大。

people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; boring AI like radiology will matter most.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科这类“无聊的 AI”将带来巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data beats raw compute as the real scaling limit.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调企业应利用专有数据做微调；并指出限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

views.en: Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability; AI centralizes rather than democratizes power.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他判断智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时立场深化为：AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术，数据投毒是比黑客攻击更紧迫的近期威胁。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement begins; agents finally work, starting with coding in late 2025.
views.zh: 2026 年他宣告缩放定律依然成立、质疑回报递减者错了，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式；智能体在 2025 年底终于真正可用，从编程起步并扩展到个人智能体。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from full open source to selective safety-gated release; model welfare matters.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕这一信念重建组织；Meta 的立场从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，并首次提出应给予模型道德考量，即模型福祉。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调产品第一性原理是潜在需求，并要为六个月后的模型而非当下的模型构建；能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手最有价值。

views.en: Coding is becoming solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初他判断编码正被解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写出，软件工程师头衔将让位于“构建者”。

views.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; agents' tool use drives exponential growth, with code volume per engineer up 250%.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他主张通过尽早发布来研究安全，智能体的工具使用带来指数级增长，人均代码量上升约 250%。

views.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; bottlenecks shift to code review, security, and idea generation, framed by ROI.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环，瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意生成，并以 ROI 而非成本来评估。

views.en: Delete most system prompts and code each model; less instruction, empirical iteration, and proactive memory-driven agents define the frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张每代模型都删掉大部分系统提示与代码，少给指令、靠经验迭代，前沿转向主动、带记忆的智能体。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste, not planning, is the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜，稀缺的是产品品味而非规划能力。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents like Claude Code building themselves.
views.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师把实现委派出去，专注产品品味与商业判断，Claude Code 这类智能体甚至参与构建自身。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaces hand-holding.
views.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束，系统提示缩减 80%，靠模型自身判断取代手把手引导。

views.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite new models drop in without regressions.
views.zh: 2026 年，重写代码变得可行：代码库即规格说明，配合强评估套件，新模型可无缝替换且不引入回归。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; safe AGI mission unifies fast cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年，吃自己的狗粮并以明确的留存与打磨标准把关每个功能；安全 AGI 的使命统一团队，支撑快速跨组织决策。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。
